# checkly_static_ips (Data Source)

Static IP addresses for Checkly's runner infrastructure. Useful when you need to allowlist Checkly traffic.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All static IP addresses that Checkly's runners use.
data "checkly_static_ips" "all" {}

# Only the IPv4 addresses of two locations.
data "checkly_static_ips" "eu_ipv4" {
  locations = ["eu-central-1", "eu-west-1"]
  ip_family = "IPv4"
}

# Allow traffic from those runners to a service behind an AWS security group.
# The addresses are already in CIDR notation, such as "3.64.0.1/32".
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "checkly_ingress" {
  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = tolist(data.checkly_static_ips.eu_ipv4.addresses)
  security_group_id = "sg-0123456789abcdef0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ip_family` (String) Specify the IP family you want to get static IPs for. The allowed values are `all` (both families), `IPv4` and `IPv6`. (Default `all`).
- `locations` (Set of String) Specify the locations you want to get static IPs for, such as `eu-central-1`. A location that has no static IPs, such as a misspelled or private one, adds no addresses and gives a warning. When not set, the addresses of every location are returned.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Set of String) Static IP addresses for Checkly's runner infrastructure, in CIDR notation (for example `3.64.0.1/32`).
- `id` (String) ID of the static IPs data source.
